name: omp-pocket-app
description: Mobile PWA control center for omp coding agents, based on the omp collab guest protocol

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./index.html --outdir=dist --minify --define process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --entry-naming=[hash].[ext] --chunk-naming=[hash].[ext] --asset-naming=[hash].[ext] && mv dist/*.html dist/index.html && cp -R public/. dist/ && sed -i 's#\./public/#/#g' dist/index.html
